many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

def predict_outputs(inputs, line_row, grid_h=12, grid_w=8):
    """Predict outputs based on verified pattern"""
    outputs = {}
    
    for r, c in inputs:
        if r >= line_row:  # below line
            outputs[(r,c)] = set()
            continue
        
        D = line_row - r
        
        # Pattern rules verified against all demos:
        if D <= 2:
            # toward + 2 perps + 2 diagonals at (line-D-1, c±2)
            pts = set()
            if 0 <= r+1 < grid_h:
                pts.add((r+1, c))  # toward
            if 0 <= c-1 < grid_w:
                pts.add((r, c-1))  # left perp
            if 0 <= c+1 < grid_w:
                pts.add((r, c+1))  # right perp
                
            # Diagonals: (line-D-1, c±2)
            diag_r = line_row - D - 1
            if 0 <= diag_r < grid_h:
                if 0 <= c-2 < grid_w:
                    pts.add((diag_r, c-2))
                if 0 <= c+2 < grid_w:
                    pts.add((diag_r, c+2))
            outputs[(r,c)] = pts

def predict_correct(inputs, line_row):
    outputs = set()
    for r, c in inputs:
        if r >= line_row:  # below line
            continue
        
        D = line_row - r
        
        if D <= 2:
            # toward + 2 perps + 2 diags
            # Diagonals at (input_r - D + 1, input_c±2)
            diag_r = r - D + 1
            if r+1 < 12:  # toward (down)
                outputs.add((r+1, c))
            if c-1 >= 0:
                outputs.add((r, c-1))  # left perp
            if c+1 < 8:
                outputs.add((r, c+1))  # right perp
            if diag_r >= 0 and c-2 >= 0:
                outputs.add((diag_r, c-2))  # diag left
            if diag_r >= 0 and c+2 < 8:
                outputs.add((diag_r, c+2))  # diag right
                
        elif D == 3:
            # toward + 2 perps
            if r+1 < 12:
                outputs.add((r+1, c))
            if c-1 >= 0:
                outputs.add((r, c-1))
            if c+1 < 8:
                outputs.add((r, c+1))
                
        else:  # D > 3
            # toward only
            if r+1 < 12:
                outputs.add((r+1, c))
    
    return sorted(outputs)
